name: corona
label: Corona 9-12 (3ds Max)

maps.notes: sRGB. Leave Corona's colour management alone on this one.
Corona 7 and later take roughness directly, linear. Pre-7 versions want Glossiness, which is not a plain inversion of this file.
Green +Y (+OpenGL). Corona reads the normal as non-colour; a normal map imported through an sRGB path is the most common invisible mistake in this whole list.

The file carries 0..1 height, not millimetres. CoronaDisplacementMod controls the depth by screen size in pixels, so the amplitude on this entry is a starting point for other renderers rather than a number Corona reads.
Corona has its own AO. This file is for masking and for other renderers.
sRGB. Coronas's emission strength is a material value.

notes: Corona: displacement is controlled by screen size (px), not a physical amount. Start at 2 px and lower it until the mortar depth reads correctly. Higher resolution height maps need a smaller screen size, not a larger one.
Every data map is read with gamma 1.0. The albedo is the only file that is colour.

Corona 9-12 take roughness on the roughness input. If you are on an older build, the Glossiness input wants the legacy curve, which is not shipped here -- say so rather than inverting the map by hand.
The most-missed setting in a Corona export is the displacement mode: screen size in pixels, not millimetres.
